|lore=Mennotor DAS-430 electromagnetic projectile launcher. Often mistaken for a blaster rifle. Fires small hollow darts filled with neurotoxin which cause temporary paralysis.
|game_text=Use 1 Force to deploy on a bounty hunter (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and opponent loses 2 Force if target is a [Maintenance] or [[Permanent Weapon]] character) if destiny +1 > defense value.

|notes=The remastered slip for IG-88's Neural Inhibitor uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions keep the deployment and targeting costs, capture threshold, and a 2-Force loss after a qualifying capture. The remastered slip represents Maintenance and Permanent Weapon with their icons.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 41.
